NandGame:Levels:ASSEMBLER_NETWORK_RECEIV.code:
# consts
DEFINE PTR 0
DEFINE SCR 0x4000
DEFINE SCR_END 0x6000
DEFINE MASK 512

# ram[ptr] = screen
A = SCR
D = A
A = PTR
*A = D

LABEL LOOP

    A = PTR
    D = *A
    A = SCR_END
    D = D - A
    A = RET
    # if ptr > scr_end, return
    D ; JGE

    # section color
    A = PTR
    D = *A
    A = MASK
    D = D & A

    # if 0 => draw_dark (0)
    # else draw_bright (-1)
    A = DRAW_DARK
    D ; JNE

LABEL DRAW_BRIGHT
    A = PTR
    A = *A
    *A = -1
    A = MOV_PTR
    0 ; JMP

LABEL DRAW_DARK
    A = PTR
    A = *A
    *A = 0

LABEL MOV_PTR
    # ram[0]++
    A = PTR
    D = *A + 1
    *A = D

    # repeat main loop
    A = LOOP
    0 ; JMP

# end program (return)
LABEL RET
    A = RET
    0 ; JMP

NandGame:Levels:ASSEMBLER_DISPLAY.code:
# Loop counter ram
DEFINE LC_ADDR 0x002
DEFINE DISP_START 0x4000
DEFINE DISP_POS_ADDR 0x003
# i = 16
# RAM[LC_ADDR] = 16
A = 16
D = A
A = LC_ADDR
*A = D

# RAM[DISP_POS_ADDR] = DISP_START
A = DISP_START
D = A
A = DISP_POS_ADDR
*A = D

#for i in 0..i
LOOP:
    # *DISP_POS_ADDR = -1
    A = DISP_POS_ADDR
    D = *A          
    A = D           
    *A = -1

    # pos += 20
    A = 0x020
    D = D + A
    A = DISP_POS_ADDR
    # RAM[DISP_POS_ADDR] = pos
    *A = D 

    # i -= 1
    A = LC_ADDR 
    D = *A
    D = D - 1
    *A = D

    # jmp > 0
    A = LOOP
    D; JGT
END:
